notes.title: Grindwheel Games Store Update
notes.content:
As part of the new countdown process, each page will be accompanied with a release on our TeePublic store.  The check out the apparel and other items you can get featuring the Cartomancy Deck art, follow the link below.

https://www.teepublic.com/t-shirt/35746667-cartomancy-deck

Due to the limited store space, I have taken the decisions to retire the Logo and Title art from there for now, but we will soon have those places filled with the latest artwork from Muthur Brine.  Stay tuned for the cover art release, going live on Halloween.
